description: This file contains test cases written with 'vitest' for the setup wizard proxy and related functions in a TypeScript project. It tests functionalities like delegation of resolve, prepare, and finalize methods, and proxy creation mechanisms for setting up channels.

classes.name: ChannelSetupWizard
classes.description: TypeScript type imported for channel setup wizard objects, defining the interface for setup wizard instances.

methods.name: createDelegatedResolveConfigured
methods.description: Creates a function that delegates the resolution of whether a channel is configured to a loaded wizard.

methods.name: createDelegatedPrepare
methods.description: Creates a function that delegates the preparation step of channel setup to a loaded wizard.

methods.name: createDelegatedFinalize
methods.description: Creates a function that delegates the finalization step of channel setup to a loaded wizard.

methods.name: createAllowlistSetupWizardProxy
methods.description: Constructs a proxy object for the setup wizard that handles allowlist and allow-from configuration, with fallback options.

methods.name: createDelegatedSetupWizardProxy
methods.description: Builds a proxied setup wizard object that delegates various status and setup functions to an underlying wizard with added properties.
